description: This file declares the Pause class, which implements the IPlayerTask interface for pausing media playback within the Rialto server's generic tasks. It includes references to context and player interfaces, and defines the execute method.

classes.name: Pause
classes.description: A class representing a pause task for the generic media player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pause task with the given context and player references.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the pause operation on the media player.
